impact: provenance._span_units splits a span over 3 lines into line units only when it does not end with . ! or ?. A block of bare lines whose last line ends with a period stays one unit, so a one-line edit marks the whole block and the reviewer gets it all. Real long sentences stay reflow-proof under the current rule. Check in the T-045 QA pass with real session data whether a line-count cap for terminated spans is worth the reflow cost.
title: Provenance keeps a bare block that ends with a period as one unit
